synthetic.expected_labels: gold field in every declared JSONL case
synthetic.protected_pool_policy: invented fixtures only; no private messages

grandfathered.expected_labels: legacy expected field; regression only, never fresh test
grandfathered.protected_pool_policy: local regression only; never production evidence

private-canonical.expected_labels: revision-bound submitted or adjudicated canonical labels
private-canonical.protected_pool_policy: local secure workbench only; no Git, CI, telemetry, or hosted services

shared_scoring.classification: exact none/abstain/posted among labelled cases; malformed and runtime_failure are distinct outcomes
shared_scoring.transaction: posted precision and recall; false posted and missed posted counts
shared_scoring.fields: exact normalized amount minor units and currency, direction, account reference, and available counterparty
shared_scoring.source_grounding: strict host parser validates Unicode-scalar half-open source spans; report rejection reasons and exact gold spans where available
shared_scoring.abstention: predicted abstain rate and gold-abstain correctness
shared_scoring.failure: malformed and runtime failure counts with sanitized reason codes
shared_scoring.latency: host elapsed milliseconds per completed case; cross-device latency is not a parity claim

android_target_gguf.runtime: llama-cpp-python on WSL host with GGUF embedded chat template and GBNF grammar

apple_fm_python.output_contract: guided flat response mapped without repair to direct strict extractor JSON
apple_fm_python.runtime: apple-fm-sdk on compatible macOS Apple Silicon, system-managed on-device model
